title: Trial room, left side. (the sangeet)
format: reel (12 s, 1080x1920, 30 fps, seamless loop, designed cover; no audio track: add an instrumental with dhol from Instagram's Sound Collection at publish, about 100 bpm, no lyrics, cuts on the downbeats at 4.6 / 7.5 / 10.5 s; optional SFX 'curtain rings on a metal rail' at 0.10 s and 10.50 s)
caption:
Trial room, left side. Matched for the sangeet, now try it with the outfit.

The Bold Nocturne trio: a paperclip chain and a pair of drops, each with a pavé link of clear cubic zirconia, and a bracelet of bold polished links. Chain ₹1,799, bracelet ₹1,599, drops ₹1,299.

Take 2 pieces for 10% off or 3 for 20% off: the bag applies BUY2 or BUY3 for you at checkout.

[ bold nocturne · 18k gold tone plated · back row, front row ]
alt_text: Reel cover on deep oxblood: a drawn brass curtain rail and floor-length oxblood velvet curtains, gathered into gold cords and tied back half-open on an arched gold-coloured mirror. In the mirror a chunky gold-tone paperclip chain with one pavé link is worn at an open white collar, a hand resting at the collar. Cream text reads The match, N° 10, sangeet. Trial room, left side. Matched for the sangeet, now try it with the outfit. An ivory tag tied to the mirror with a gold thread reads Shade N° 10, matched to the sangeet, a pavé link on the chain.

Reel: under the words Trial room, left side, the velvet curtains slide open on the mirror. Pink tailor's chalk traces the chain down to its one pavé link and circles it, with the note one pavé link. It cuts to the Bold Nocturne chain, bracelet and drops landing on a dark red sequin fabric, overlapping lac-red discs with a few gold catch-lights, and a Shade N° 10 tag swings in on its thread: One outfit. Three pieces. The end card reads The sangeet, matched. Chain ₹1,799, bracelet ₹1,599, drops ₹1,299, 18K gold tone plated, nairaflore.com, above the three pieces in a row. Then the curtains close halfway again, back to the first frame.
deviations: TAG (cover and scene 3, grid-director fix 1, 26 Oct): SHADE N° 10's chip is the ground's own lac #42060E. The system now draws every chip as an inset 208x48 window framed by paper, so the chip no longer vanishes into the ground and the tag keeps the nine-tag silhouette; the page-level 'paper core' script (the forEach block after system.js, which drew a 1.5px ivory edge round the chip and a ring at the hole) is deleted from _work/build.py and so from cover.html and reel.html.

COVER TYPE at x96, not the spec's x72 (eyebrow, headline and turn keep one left edge). At x72 the left tail's right edge sat 12-13px from the headline and turn, so TRIAL ROOM, / LEFT SIDE. and both turn lines looked pinned to the curtain; with the 46px tail the gap is now about 50px. Measured after the move: eyebrow x96-536 (clear of the x907 zone), headline x98-678 (inside the x740 limit), turn x97-491. The eyebrow is the system's: 20px on baseline 352 (grid-tile cap top y97, level with P12 and P11 beside it; it was 22px on b400, a 47px step in the top row). The in-video headline and note in the reel stay at x72: no tail sits beside them.

DRAPES drawn as SVG paths, not CSS boxes with border-bottom-right-radius 70% 120px. The box version reads as a rounded rectangle sitting on a strip. Half-open (frame 0 and cover): the inner edge falls from the rail at x380 / x700 and sweeps in one curve into the tie, so the opening is an arch that echoes the mirror's. Fully open: the same drape at scaleX .658 (250px, as specced) hangs straighter, straight to y600 and then the sweep. The path morphs (CSS d) on the spec's ease while the panel scales, so the note at x72-207 clears the edge by about 35px. FOLDS: not the spec's single repeating-linear-gradient. Clipped by the sweep, its vertical stripes stopped dead against the curve below y850 and each panel read as a striped CSS shape. The cloth is drawn as 6 fold bands per panel, same outline, same 5-stop ramp (#5A1018 / #4A0C14 / #330509): each band edge falls straight from its rail point x_i (y476) to y760, then curves 'C x_i 900, .6x_i 1080, 11i 1177' into the pinch, so the bands converge into x0-66 at the cord; the sixth edge is the swept outline itself. Each band is shaded across its width with the ramp (11 slices, crest on the band edges, the #330509 trough in the middle, a 1.6px sRGB blur so no slice edge shows), and the troughs darken toward the pinch (#330509 to #2A0407). Every band edge carries the outline's d morph (open: straight to y870, then 'C x_i 990, .68x_i 1112, 11i 1177'), so the fully open drape still gathers into the tie. The '40px inner-edge shadow' is a cast shadow onto the mirror (drop-shadow 9px, 14px blur, 55%) plus a 3px ruby #8E1B2B sheen along the velvet's rolled edge (a system swatch colour), so the lac curtain separates from the lac wall. A 10px darker heading sits under the rings.

TIEBACK, TAILS, TASSELS: the 6px gold cord wraps the gathered drape at the pinch (x0-56, y about 1175, a slight sag, a 1.5px date-gold highlight), not across the full panel width. Tails start at the pinch, 46px wide, and run from y1171 to y1920, bleeding off the bottom edge (spec: hem at y1700), flaring to 58px at y1920: hemmed at y1700, the floor-length curtains hung in mid-air over a 220px band of bare lac on the full 9:16 cover and in every curtain frame. 46px, not the first build's 60px, so on the cover the right tail's inner edge (x1034 at y1290-1340) clears the tag's top-right corner (x1025) by about 8px instead of overlapping it by 7px, and the headline at x96 gets about 50px from the left tail. The fold bands' pinch points follow the narrower gather (edge i meets the cord at i x 8.67px, edge 6 at the outline's x52), so no two edges cross at the tie. The grid tile (y240-1680) and the 4:5 crop are unchanged. Each tail shows three folds fanning out of the pinch, darkest just under the cord, in the same ramp as the upper panel. Tails belong to the drape group, so fully open they compress with it (to about 30px) instead of standing wider than the pinch above them. Tassels hang at x32 / x1048, the knot at the front of the gathered drape, not at x60 / x1020: at x60 the 40px fringe hung about 6px from the T of TRIAL on the cover. Each is a knot, a cap and seven 2px gold lines, 40px overall.

TASSEL SWAY: a swing that decays (3, -2.6, 1.7, -1.0, 0.45, 0 deg) when the curtain opens, and again (-2.6, 1.3, 0) when it closes, about the knot, instead of a constant 3 s ±3 deg loop. It is at rest by 4.6 s and by 11.8 s, so the final 0.2 s hold matches frame 0 exactly. The cover shows the tassels hanging straight.

RAIL AND RINGS: the rail runs x8-1072 with its d24 finials at x8 and x1072, part off-canvas, so the panels (x0-1080) hang from the rail rather than 40-70px of velvet hanging from nothing past the finials (first build: rail x40-1040). Six rings per panel at x70 + i x 59.2 (mirrored on the right). They slide i/5 x 130px as specced and sit on the rail line, the fabric heading hiding their lower arc.
PAVÉ LINK measured at canvas (568, 869), not about (560, 855): photo source (656, 927), measured on a gridded 2x crop. The push (1.00 to 1.04) is centred on the link, so the chalk stays registered.

CHALK: the blush dashed line runs 15px inside the chain's curve rather than over the links, so the dashes never cover the piece. It is 6px wide with 18/10 dashes (round caps), not the spec's 4px 12/8: at the 391px phone width 4px dashes on skin dropped to about 1.4px and vanished, so the trace read as a circle popping on; the reveal mask is 18px to cover the wider line. It traces the left run from the collar and stops 7px short of the ring. The ring is a solid hand-drawn 5px blush loop (r34 opening to 37, a 12 deg overshoot), not a dashed circle, so it reads as a chalk mark. Both carry a 1px soft shadow, because blush alone measures about 1.8:1 on the skin tones.

SCENE 3 THREAD ANCHOR (815, 798) (26 Oct; (815, 638) before the scene moved down 160 px): the bracelet's right-most link, measured on the matte's hull after the -8 deg rotation. The spec's 'about (835, 690)' falls on bare print about 50px below and right of the piece. The thread is redrawn each frame from the tag's hole as it swings in, so it really carries the tag.

SCENE 3 SHADOWS AND SWATCH: on the sequin print the kit's light-ground cut-out shadow disappeared and the pieces sank into the gold dots. They now carry drop-shadow(0 4px 5px rgba(20,4,6,.55)) and drop-shadow(0 14px 20px rgba(20,4,6,.40)), plus the specced contact ellipses, which fade in as each piece lands. The sequin swatch uses the system's dark-fill texture (AI-1 relief, soft-light .55, system deviation 4), not raw AI-1 at soft-light .45. Since 26 Oct the swatch carries the system's new sequin print (grid-director fix 3: overlapping lac discs, 8% bronze, 22% small gold glints) and the old opt-ins data-sequin-opacity / -arc are removed (they belonged to the dot tile): at full-strength dots the chain loop read as a ring of dots among dots at phone width and the frame looked like polka-dot gift wrap; now the dots read as reflective sequins and the plated pieces are the brightest gold in the frame (99th-percentile luminance: chain 211, print 154). The swatch is 870 wide, not 840, so the tag sits about 15px inside the pinked right edge instead of overhanging it; only cloth enters the x>=960 icon zone. The swatch carries data-sheen="false": the system's 120deg white screen sheen (.14) lifted the lac silk between the dots from rgb(89,18,23) to rgb(107,43,48) in a diagonal band that read as a smear on the lens, brightest of all at 4.60-4.85 s when the swatch is alone. The spec gives the print no sheen; the ground now measures rgb(90,20,27) evenly across the swatch. Shared system files untouched.

TAG SWING: it fades in over 5.40-5.46 s while it drops (the spec gives no opacity), so it does not pop in at -120px, and the paper is opaque from its second visible frame (frame 164): faded over the fast part of --ease-drop (to 5.54 s, first build) it arrived half-transparent with the sequins showing through and read as a cross-fade. It swings 12 to 6 deg about its hole on --ease-drop, then sways -1.8 / +1.5 / -0.6 deg until the cut.

END CARD TIMING: the spec's 'prices, kicker and URL fade in from 8.20 s' and 'at least 2.3 s of full hold' cannot both hold. The headline rises 7.50-8.10 and 7.62-8.22, the trio rises at 7.60 / 7.72 / 7.84 (0.7 s each), and the prices, kicker and URL fade in at 8.05 / 8.15 / 8.25 (0.35 s). Everything is complete by 8.60 s, a 1.9 s full hold; the prices are on screen and readable from about 8.2 s (2.3 s).

MIRROR: the 4px between the 10px gold frame and the glass is a gold-deep #B0843A inner lip, not bare wall, and the frame casts a soft shadow (0 18px 26px, 45%) on the wall. The 2px date-gold line sits 6px inside the outer edge as specced.

FILES: the reel is reel.mp4 (the task's name), not p10.mp4. The page holds every animation at t=0 until the renderer seeks it: left running while the page loaded, the first captured frame showed the curtain about 0.6 s into its opening.

CAPTION FACT: 'a bracelet of bold polished links and pavé drops' parsed as the bracelet carrying pavé drops (the construction claim kept off the bracelet), and the drops' pavé lacked the cubic zirconia qualifier. Now: 'a paperclip chain and a pair of drops, each with a pavé link of clear cubic zirconia, and a bracelet of bold polished links.' (chain listing: 'one link pavé set with clear cubic zirconia'; drops listing: 'a polished oval link ... with a larger pavé set oval link below'; both tagged Cubic Zirconia; the bracelet stays construction-free). Changed in the brief's P10 caption too. OFFER LINE: 'Take 2 pieces for 10% off or 3 for 20% off: the bag applies BUY2 or BUY3 for you at checkout.', the wording P9 and P11 carry (brand bible section 6: the bag applies the rungs itself). The brief's P10 offer line is left as the brief's. Alt text corrected to the build: the tag is tied to the mirror and carries its detail line, the eyebrow is read out, and a second alt text describes the reel.

END CARD TRIO: chain 330 wide at (245, 1135), bracelet 290 at (590, 1135), drops 230 at (880, 1135) (26 Oct: y975 + 160), not 300 / 260 / 200 on y950: at phone width the drops were about 70px across and the row weighed left (95px left margin, 145px right). Extents now x80-410, 445-735, 765-995; the URL moves from b1220 to b1240, about 45px under the chain's lowest link; everything stays above y1250 and inside x72-1008. Contact ellipses are placed by the system from each matte's hull, 6px under the new lowest pixels.

SCENE 3 AND END CARD MOVED DOWN (grid-director fix, 26 Oct): both blocks sat at about y370-1250 with ~650 px of empty lac below; each moves down 160 px so it centres near y960 inside y250-1650. Scene 3: 'ONE OUTFIT. THREE PIECES.' b580 (was b420), swatch y660 (was 500), chain / bracelet / drops centres (330,980) / (700,800) / (640,1060) with their drop transform-origins, tag y980 (hole NF.tagHole(770,980,6,.8) = (877.11,1006.2)), thread anchor (815,798). End card: THE SANGEET, b630 / MATCHED. b720 (were b470 / b560), prices b810, plating b860, trio y1135, NAIRAFLORE.COM b1400 (was b1240). Frame 0, the curtain beats and the loop are unchanged (frame 0 against the previous render: the H.264 floor).

SEQUIN PRINT (grid-director fix 3, 26 Oct): beat 3's chain, bracelet and drops had sat on a gold polka-dot grid that competed with them; the swatch is now the system's seeded lac-disc sequin tile, a tone-on-tone shimmer under which the three pieces are the brightest gold in the frame.

Grid-remaining pass (26 Oct, system only): SF1 maker's mark (system, 26 Oct): every non-mini tag now carries the flower as a crisp 18x26 blush mark at (111,286) in the tag's lower third, 8px above the inner gold rule, instead of the 62x90 ghost at 12% behind the second name line and the detail (read as a pink smudge at 100%). The tag shows on the cover and in the reel's tag beat (scale .8).
checks: PRICES = roster.json (25 Oct): chain ₹1,799 (compare-at ₹4,899, never shown), bracelet ₹1,599 (compare-at ₹3,200, never shown), drops ₹1,299. Shown only on the end card (Jost 500 + Poppins ₹) and in the caption. No MRP, code, percentage or offer on any frame. Re-read Shopify on the morning of the render and the evening of Mon 16 Nov.
STOCK 25 Oct: chain 53, bracelet 49, drops 19, all single-variant, none pre-order; none at 1-3.

CLAIMS: '[ 18K GOLD TONE PLATED ]' on the end card (all three tagged 18k Gold Tone Plated); 'gold tone' / 'gold-tone' everywhere, never bare 'gold'. Pavé is claimed only for the chain (tag, note, caption) and the drops (caption), and in the caption both carry 'of clear cubic zirconia', so pavé cannot read as diamonds; the sentence puts the pavé on the chain and the drops only. The bracelet is 'bold polished links' only (its listing conflict stays an open question), though its real photo shows its pavé link. No waterproof, tarnish-free or hypoallergenic claim. PAVÉ is never set in Velista: the note and the tag detail are Cormorant, the prices Jost. No em dashes, exclamation marks, emoji, urgency or dates on the art. No non-Latin strings in this post.

OFFER LINE (caption only): BUY2 10% (min 2) and BUY3 20% (min 3), live per the brand bible section 6. The bag applies them itself and only one code reaches Fastrr; the caption offers them as alternatives ('or'), never stacked, and never as codes to type. Wording: 'Take 2 pieces for 10% off or 3 for 20% off: the bag applies BUY2 or BUY3 for you at checkout.', identical to P9 and P11 only. FLAG: P3, P8 and P12 still carry the older 'Take 2 pieces for 10% off or 3 for 20% off. The bag applies BUY2 or BUY3 for you.' and need the same change (as does the brief's offer line for P3, P8, P9, P10, P11 and P12). The trio is a 3-piece BUY3 basket.

WORN PLATE: assets/shopify/bold-nocturne-chain/04.png is the chain's own PDP photo, a real photograph that does not read as synthetic, so the fallback was not needed. Crop (150,300,1050,1480): the frame's top edge is at the jaw line, no lips or face. Shown at 0.50x native, 0.52x at the 1.04 push. The cover renders at 2x and peaks at 1.04x native before the 1080 export.

RESOLUTION: cut-outs at a fraction of native: chain a01 360/882 (scene 3) and 330/882 (end), bracelet 280/1164 and 290/1164, drops 200/619 and 230/619. Mattes checked zoomed on lac in scene 3 and on the end card: crisp, no plaster halo, contact shadows under each piece.

CONTRAST measured on rendered pixels against the lightest 2% of the background behind each line: cover headline cream 13.7:1, turn blush 10.7:1, eyebrow kicker 11.3:1 (same colour and ground at 20px); note blush on the new fold bands 9.3:1; reel headline 13.6:1; end-card price, kicker and URL kicker 11.6:1; tag labels warm grey on paper 5.4:1 (the lowest), tag detail ink-soft 10.9:1.

SAFE AREAS: in the cover's grid tile (y240-1680) the eyebrow cap is at y337 (tile y97, level with P12 y97 and P11 y97) and the tag bottom at about y1622; x>=907 and y240-442 are empty flat lac (measured). Cover type at x96: eyebrow x96-536, headline x98-678 (limit x740), turn x97-491, about 50px clear of the left tail. The cover tag's right edge (x1025) clears the right tail (x1033) by about 8px. The 4:5 crop (y285-1635) holds everything. Tails bleed off y1920, outside the grid tile. Reel words: headline b420 (cap top about y373), note y844-935, 'ONE OUTFIT. THREE PIECES.' b580, end card ink about y566-1400 (since 26 Oct), all within x72-1008 and the y250-1650 band. Nothing in the right-rail zone (x>=960, y1100-1700) but the right tail, which is scenery; in scene 3 only the pinked swatch enters x>=960 (to x1001), the tag ends at about x975, y1092.

MOTION: hard cuts at 4.60 / 7.50 / 10.50 s (frames 138 / 225 / 315, on the downbeats). Holds: headline 0-4.3 s; mirror and chalk 1.6-4.6 s; scene 3 line 5.2-7.5 s; end card full from 8.6 to 10.5 s. One hero movement per beat (curtain, chalk, pieces landing then the tag, end card). The only overshoot is --ease-drop on the landings. No shake, spin or whip. The fold bands morph with the outline through the opening (0.10-1.60 s) and the close (10.50-11.60 s) and gather into the tie at every frame between. Fix pass checked in the page at 0, 1.6, 3.8, 5.0, 5.43, 5.46, 5.5, 6.5, 9.0, 11.95 s, at 391px wide for 3.8 (dashes now read), 5.0 and 6.5 (pieces brighter than the print), and in the mp4 at 0, 0.5, 0.9, 1.6, 2.6, 3.2, 3.8, 4.55, 4.62, 5.0, 5.43, 5.47, 6.5, 7.6, 8.2, 9.0, 10.55, 10.9, 11.3, 11.6, 11.95 s and frames 161-166 (tag: absent, absent, nearly opaque, opaque).
